purpose: Prospective controlled context ablation on an actual previously sealed retail analysis, using the same official DeepSeek runtime. Not a model accuracy leaderboard or production-user study.
source: evidence/deepseek-runtime-results.json monthly-investigation actual complete transcript and sealed report; shared input strips display-only details for every variant
ground_truth: report ID plus net_sales delta and leading country/delta, taken from the sealed deterministic evidence; never supplied to the model in the current question
parameters: BM25k1=1.2,b=.75; history value/size greedy with fixed .15 recency term; no tuning after results

variants.upstream-full: Original npm Pi1.6.0, identical full transcript and utility tool definitions, no context policy
variants.recency-window: Original npm Pi1.6.0 plus whole-user-turn recency window capped at16KiB, no archival manifest
variants.budgeted-native: Actual modified Pi core using native request policy, immutable spill/recall, protocol checks and relevance/size history selection capped at16KiB

limits: No retries for better scores; preserve every charged unknown and failure. Historical transcript messages do not count as new calls or new billed tokens. No local model or GPU.
dataset_note: Documentation distraction turns are explicitly controlled benchmark additions from MIT upstream README, not a claim of real customer conversations.
